title: Capture mode activates under --headless despite requiring a renderer
detail: _activated() validates only the user arg, never the display server. `godot --headless -- --capture` reaches _shot's get_texture().get_image() with no renderer — only dir/save errors are handled.
recommended_fix: In _activated() (or _run()), return false / quit(1) with a clear error when OS.has_feature("headless") is true.
